finalText:
**Big but mostly safe: 1291 hits in 94 files.**

Four zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Hits | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | Public contract. Rename breaks clients. |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) `WIRE` values | 2 | Frozen wire names. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Applied history. Edits break the down step. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Regenerated. Edits get wiped. |

The DB column is also still `account_id`. That name is baked into ~250 SQL lines in the repo files. Renaming those needs a real column migration first.

Sign off only if the plan is JS identifiers, not wire or SQL names.
